name: Pomegranate
overview: The pomegranate is a significant fruit in Scripture, symbolizing the fruitfulness and blessing of the land of Canaan, as seen when the spies brought its fruit to demonstrate the land's abundance (Numbers 13:23). It was also artistically represented on the hem of the high priest's robe, embroidered in vibrant colors and paired with golden bells, highlighting its sacred role in worship (Exodus 28:33-34; 39:24). Additionally, pomegranates were carved on the temple pillars, reflecting their importance in Israel's religious life, and their juice was used to make spiced wine, illustrating both their practical and symbolic value (1 Samuel 14:2; Song of Solomon 8:2).
